Academic Projects

Major Project · 2025–2026

Prediction of Active Earth Pressure on Retaining Walls

Investigated how soil properties influence lateral earth pressure on retaining walls — a critical factor in structural safety. Applied both statistical and machine learning methods to develop a predictive framework.

  • Studied influence of cohesion, friction angle, and unit weight on lateral earth pressure
  • Compared Multiple Linear Regression vs. Random Forest — ML model showed superior accuracy for nonlinear soil behaviour
  • Developed a dual-method predictive framework applicable to real-world retaining wall design
  • Research presented at ICMACET-2026 international conference
Random Forest Geotechnical Retaining Walls Machine Learning

Mini Project · 2024–2025

Mapping Building Amenities, Class & Valuation in Mumbai

Conducted a ground-level survey of residential buildings in Dahisar East and Borivali East, Mumbai — then used QGIS to spatially map and analyse how amenities relate to property valuation.

  • House-to-house survey of 21 buildings in Ashok Van & Shantivan neighbourhoods
  • Collected 10+ parameters: lifts, parking, solar panels, CCTV, fire safety, gardens, gym
  • Produced 24 vector maps visualising spatial distribution of building characteristics
  • Key finding: Buildings 30+ years old show significantly lower property valuations
QGIS GIS Mapping Urban Planning Field Survey

Major Project · Key Results

Prediction of Active Earth Pressure on Retaining Walls — two predictive models were built and compared. Model 1 (full parameter set) outperformed Model 2 on all metrics and was selected for practical application.

✦

Conclusion

Model 1 demonstrates stronger correlation (r = 0.90 vs 0.86) and higher predictive accuracy, making it the preferred model for practical retaining wall design applications.
